name: receipts
description: Claude says the tests pass. Receipts checks. Flags success claims that no check backs up.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: A: warn only. B: warn, nudge, and send Claude back once on a contradicted claim. C: send back on any unbacked claim.

smartCheck.title: Smart check
smartCheck.description: Ask a model about sentences the phrase rules can't settle. Uses your usage. Off by default.

stamp.title: Stamp line
stamp.description: Add a receipt line under each judged answer.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Commands that count as checks, besides the test and build runners Receipts knows. Each one is "tests: <command>" or "build: <command>", for example "tests: pnpm verify". The command matches with any arguments after it.

verbosity.title: Verbosity
verbosity.description: quiet: flag contradictions, and tests or build claims left unchecked after this turn's edits; the rest goes to the /receipts pane. all: show and stamp every verdict.
